decisions.reason: A newly launched vertigo combination tablet with its own product page reflects a recent approval investment, so the firm will likely keep it at least through its first full year.
Generic antidepressant capsules face tender and price pressure in Germany, but a 2024 launch with a dedicated page makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
The combination antihypertensive serves a large chronic-therapy market and was just launched with its own page, so the firm will keep it.
The bone and joint supplement is only mentioned on the website and sits outside the core pharmaceutical business, so it is more at risk, but it is cheap to keep and likely stays for now.
